description: Player is 200% bigger — harder to dodge!

description: Tap to float, hold to sink. Everything is upside down.

description: Almost no drag — velocity carries further.

description: Every pearl counts double.

name: Treasure Only
description: Regular pearls hidden — only treasure coins visible.

description: Begin every run with an Echo Shield pre-activated.

description: Power meter disabled — rely only on skill.

description: Level scrolls 30% faster than normal.

description: 30% more gap space between obstacles.

description: DarkVoid obstacle active from the very first beat.

description: Fever mode active from beat 0 — non-stop bonus!

name: One Attempt
description: No retry — one life only.

name: Random Character
description: Character randomized each attempt.

description: Score and UI hidden — play by feel.
